investigations.name: Stadtwerke Bad Nauheim GmbH / ensev GmbH
investigations.decision: remain partial; first-party anonymous tariff rule found, but current estate/fee coverage has a residual exception

evidence.operatorLineage: Stadtwerke Bad Nauheim transferred its charging infrastructure to wholly owned e-mobility subsidiary ensev GmbH; first-party states practically nothing changes for customers.
evidence.firstPartyAnonymousRule: ensev public charging tariff: AC up to 22 kW and DC up to 150 kW, ad-hoc 0.57 EUR/kWh gross + 3.00 EUR start fee per session; spontaneous smartphone/credit-card charging supported.
evidence.firstPartyEstate: ensev states 58 AC public charge points in Bad Nauheim plus public DC infrastructure; Taubenbaum adds 6 public CCS points up to 150 kW.
evidence.mobilithekCorroboration: Current Mobilithek/chargecloud station records at Frankfurter Strasse, Landesaerztekammer, Fachmarktzentrum, Hohe Strasse and other sampled ensev sites expose 0.57 EUR/kWh + 3.00 EUR start + 0.00 EUR/min blocking for AC and DC/HPC.
evidence.exception: A current Parkstrasse Mobilithek-derived surface contains at least one EVSE with no ad-hoc tariff populated while neighboring EVSEs show 0.57 + 3.00 + zero blocking.

investigations.exactGap: Need reconcile the canonical 68-EVSE denominator against the current ensev estate and close the Parkstrasse missing-tariff EVSE(s). First-party rule closes energy+start fee for AC/DC <=150 kW, but explicit zero blocking is currently evidenced on sampled Mobilithek records rather than exhaustively every EVSE.
investigations.resumeCondition: Current raw Mobilithek/chargecloud export for all canonical 68 EVSEs confirming operator=ensev, tariff 0.57 EUR/kWh, start 3.00 EUR, blocking 0.00 (or deterministic explicit rule), including Parkstrasse residuals. Then promote.

backendFamilyProgress.chargecloud_mobilithek: Bad Nauheim materially advanced: authoritative anonymous energy+start rule obtained and multiple AC/DC/HPC records confirm zero blocking; remaining issue narrowed to estate reconciliation plus Parkstrasse missing tariff field(s).

nextSafeAction: Target Bad Nauheim raw Mobilithek/chargecloud 68-EVSE export and Parkstrasse residual only. Do not repeat broad tariff search. If reconciled, promote; otherwise park and move to another chargecloud/Mobilithek operator.
